descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S24 Layout against the p72 prototype, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Matches the source-of-truth prototype layout (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html): Important Points sits in the bottom box of the Pre-Round fullscreen editor, the dictation in the top box. (TFA-92590 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given p72 prototype (handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html) and the app's Pre-Round tab and fullscreen editor in each mode

When Compare side by side: where the points box sits, its label and hint, where '+ Add Point' and the cards sit, the empty-state copy

Then Matches the prototype for each mode

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review; the reference per mode is Q9 (UAT TC-10 'The Pre-Round tab has two boxes' vs AC 1 'the bottom box of the Pre-Round fullscreen editor' vs the prototype's split). The Nursing Home empty-state copy is also judged automatically in S02 / S17

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: EXPLORATORY · Exploratory testing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
